children: Silver Creek Midstream's Powder River Basin crude oil midstream assets for ~$585M in cash.
Silver Creek owns and operates one of the largest integrated crude oil gathering systems in the Powder River Basin, providing customers with access to Plains'
existing Rockies infrastructure through the Guernsey and Fort Laramie hubs.

The acquired assets include 600 miles of crude oil gathering and transmission pipelines, more than 350K bbl/day of operating capacity, 1.2M barrels of operational storage capacity, and a 49% non-operated interest in the Powder River Gateway joint venture, including Iron Horse and Powder River Express.

said the acquisition expands its Powder River Basin footprint and increases direct connectivity to producer supply in an area supported by more than 20 years of remaining drilling locations at current activity levels, with continued production growth expected over the next several years.

title: Plains All American to buy Silver Creek Powder River Basin assets in $585M deal
